#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Build and test everything
readonly ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="$ROOT/bin:$PATH"

log() {
  printf '%s [%s] %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$1" "${*:2}" >&2
}

build_one() {
  local dir=$1 target=${2:-release}
  if [[ ! -d "$dir" ]]; then
    log error "no such directory: $dir"
    return 1
  fi
  (cd "$dir" && make "$target" -j"$(nproc)") || return $?
}

for dir in "$ROOT"/packages/*/; do
  case "$(basename "$dir")" in
    docs|examples) continue ;;
    *) build_one "$dir" ;;
  esac
done

cat <<EOF2 > "$ROOT/out/summary.txt"
Built at $(date)
Commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
EOF2

while read -r line; do
  echo "${line//foo/bar}" | sed -e 's/a/b/g' | awk '{ print $1 }'
done < input.txt

count=$(( count + 1 ))
if (( count > 10 )); then echo "many"; fi
arr=(one "two three" 'four')
echo "${#arr[@]} items: ${arr[*]}"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
test -f "$tmp/x" && echo yes || echo no
function cleanup {
  rm -f /tmp/lock
}
exit 0
